title: MonkeyBiz Workout Plan v7
author: Monkeybiz
desc: Unlock your potential with the MonkeyBiz 12-Week Program! Designed for those ready to elevate their fitness journey, this program spans three days a week, focusing on strength, endurance, and functional movement. Each session is crafted to challenge your limits while promoting recovery and growth. Commit to this transformative 12-week plan and watch your body and performance thrive!
